newsitem.title: CANADA: Agrium to list on New York Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Agrium to list on New York Stock Exchange.

text.p: Canadian fertilizer company Agrium Inc said on Monday that it was cleared to file its listing application with the New York Stock Exchange and expected its shares to start trading on the exchange on October 4.

Agrium said it would voluntarily delist its stock from Nasdaq, where an average of 174,000 shares per day have traded since its listing in May 1995. The company is also listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

"A listing on the Big Board will permit investors in the United States and abroad to share in the future growth of Agrium in the same way they invest in other major companies in the fertilizer industry," Agrium chief executive John Van Brunt said in a statement.
The company said its newly listed stock would trade under the symbol AGU, as it is in Toronto. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
